item.title: Budapest Transport Museum Receives a Rolls-Royce Aircraft Engine
item.description: The Hungarian Museum of Science, Technology and Transport has received a Rolls-Royce aircraft engine. item.title: Fewer Crimes, Safer Streets: Hungarian Police Deliver Excellent 2025 Results
item.description: In 2025, Hungary recorded approximately 179,000 criminal offenses — a notable decrease compared to the previous year. The decline was visible across most categories, including street crimes and serious offenses, returning figures closer to pre-2024 levels. Based on the National Police Headquarters’ data (ORFK), registered crimes dropped by around 12% overall.
